job.name: ig18_gran_c
job.meaning: бабушка ~80, белый пуховый платок на голове, тёмно-синее платье, у окна с геранью, зимний свет
job.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a gentle Russian grandmother about 80 wearing a white Orenburg down shawl loosely over her grey hair, a dark navy dress with tiny white dots. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, gentle loving expression, kind eyes with smile wrinkles, NO broad smile, mouth relaxed. Natural skin texture with real wrinkles and age spots, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch, NOT airbrushed. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a window with red geraniums in pots and a lace curtain, snow outside, softly blurred, soft winter daylight.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary elderly person (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real and warm.
